name: Destroyer's Legacy alone does not unlock Pyroclasm; 23 invested tab points does (#7996)
contract: CharacterAdvancement.dbc (Incineration, ClassType 26, Tab 62): Destroyer's Legacy (entry 11803, rank spell 704815) is TabTEInvestment 8, itself gated behind 8 TE invested in the tab's threshold-0 entries. Pyroclasm (entry 7174, rank spell 520019) is TabTEInvestment 23, RequiredEntry 0/0/0: nothing links the two entries directly.

AscensionCompat.cpp TabInvestmentShortfall / AscensionFreepickRules.cpp InvestedBelowThreshold refuse a purchase while the sum of TalentEssenceCost already invested in strictly-lower-threshold tab entries is below the entry's own TabTEInvestment. The report assumes Destroyer's Legacy leads to Pyroclasm; the DBC data has no such link, and Pyroclasm's own gate is the 23 TE invested in threshold-below-23 Incineration entries, not Destroyer's Legacy specifically.

#8685 (batch 5) listed this as open without a safe server-side fix; 7b635cdad5 (#9182) added the generic tab-investment gate afterward, for #5351/#3941, not this report. This proves the already-working, by-design behavior with an independent expected value (the DBC's own TabTEInvestment 23), not a number taken from the implementation.

steps.label: Buy the 8 threshold-0 entries Destroyer's Legacy itself needs
Pyroclasm is refused with only 9 tab points invested
Destroyer's Legacy alone does not unlock Pyroclasm
Invest 14 more tab points (23 total) without touching Destroyer's Legacy's own tier
Pyroclasm is now accepted with 23 tab points invested
